theme: hybrid (Light mode default, Dark mode toggle supported)

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 and major marketing headlines. Apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter to all headings.

body.usage: Used for standard application body text, paragraphs, and list items. Ensures tabular numerals are aligned for dashboards.

monospace.usage: CRITICAL for Skill-Gap Scores, AI metrics, data tables, and readiness labels. This gives the 'AI/Technical' feel without being overbearing.

colors.description: The primary interaction color is Obsidian Black/Stark White (Swiss Brutalist style), offset by striking 'Volt' (#C0FF00) for AI Skill-Gap highlights. Do not use generic SaaS blues.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Grid Borders (Technical)' strategy for Dashboard and Admin panels. Remove outer shadows. Rely on 1px solid borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky navigation or context overlays, use crystal clear glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) with a 1px border. Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds on headers, overlays, dropdowns, or ANY surface that has content scrolling under it.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must translate up slightly (-translate-y-1) and cast a strict, crisp shadow (shadow-md) or swap colors.
visual_enhancers.ai_elements: For skill-gap or AI scoring, use 'The Tracing Beam' or neon highlight techniques on borders to indicate AI processing/activity.

layouts.marketing_pages: Use pure HTML/Tailwind with generous spacing. Apply 'The Bento Grid Protocol - Mode A' for the landing page features. Asymmetry is required.
layouts.dashboards: Apply 'The Bento Grid Protocol - Mode B' (High Density). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use full pixel utilization (h-full).
layouts.spacing: Use 2-3x typical spacing. Inner padding of cards must be p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision with borders.

components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized to match the Swiss typography. Keep inputs rectangular with sharp or max 4px radius.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. No row borders except the bottom. Left-align data, right-align scores.
components.charts: Use Shadcn charts (recharts). Implement monochromatic bars with the accent_ai color for 'student score' vs 'required score'.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Strict high contrast.
components.readiness_labels: Use standard Badges but with uppercase Mono font and tight tracking.

motion.transitions: Avoid universal 'transition-all'. Specifically target properties: 'transition-transform transition-colors duration-200 ease-out'.
motion.microinteractions: Hover states must increase contrast. List items should have staggered entrance animations (framer-motion).

accessibility.contrast: Always ensure text meets 4.5:1 ratio. Explicitly set hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='student-login-button').

media.image_handling: Max height of 80vh on mobile. Use object-cover for all hero imagery. If using overlays, stick to bg-black/40 (do not block the image entirely).

hero_student_laptop.description: Man wearing headphones studying on a laptop. Perfect for the Student Entry Point card or Hero section.

hero_university_modern.description: Modern university architecture. Good for the Coordinator/Admin Entry Point card or background.

ai_abstract_data.description: Blue background with data lines/dots. Great for the 'Skill Gap AI Analysis' section background or assessment loading screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric centering.
Use grid-based borders for tables and dashboard widgets to achieve a 'Technical/Swiss' look.
Integrate 'Outfit' for all Headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' for Body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for Data/Scores.
Ensure all three roles (Student, Coordinator, Admin) have distinct entry points on the landing page, utilizing the provided image_urls for visual distinction.
Dashboards must hide sensitive data by default, clearly showing access scope headers (e.g., 'Viewing Department: Computer Science').
Never use pure black or pure gray. Use the defined dark slate/indigo palettes.
Apply `data-testid` to all forms, login buttons, filter dropdowns, and resume review panels.
Do not center-align paragraphs; left-align dense content.
Implement Sonner toasts for successful job applications, assessment completions, and coordinator verifications.
CRITICAL: You have .js and .jsx files, not .tsx. All instructions and components must be written using standard Javascript/JSX React syntax, stripping TS typings.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
